hooks.name: Validate comix specs on save
hooks.description: Report-only and fast: connected layout + static comix spec checks (schema, cues, timeline, catalog assets) and whether src/cinematic/generated is in sync. Rewrites nothing; run generate-comix.mjs to recompile.

action.command: node scripts/harness/validate-comix.mjs; node scripts/harness/generate-comix.mjs --validate; node scripts/harness/generate-comix.mjs --check
